test_objective: Check that an HTTP error response of type BadRequestData is raised if the Content-Type header is "application/ld+json" and a JSON-LD Link header is present in the incoming HTTP request

test_cases.name: 003_09_01 Create a batch of one entity with a Link header and a JSON-LD content type
test_cases.doc: Check that an HTTP error response of type BadRequestData is raised if the Content-Type header is "application/ld+json" and a JSON-LD Link header is present in the incoming HTTP request
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/create'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload set to a list of entities to be created
}
